purpose: Teach: 左利き/つまん/シャイ/へー/かくして/戸惑っ/うっとり/噛む

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、左利きかなあ?
lines.style: Small, genuine question. Unselfconscious curiosity. Looks up from what he's doing. No demand in it — just wondering out loud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、つまんないとか言わずに、お絵描き、続けてね。
lines.en: Mmm, and don't say it's boring — just keep drawing.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not scolding. A soft anchor back to the task, said while she's watching him work. Warm with it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、シャイで、声、小さいよね。
lines.en: Dad's kind of shy, isn't he. Has a quiet voice.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, almost thoughtful. Not criticism — just noticing something about the way things are. Pause between the two parts, like he's checking his own words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へー、よく観察してるのね。
lines.en: Oh, you really do notice things, don't you.
lines.style: Pleased recognition. Said with genuine warmth, not patronising. A small smile in the voice — she likes being seen noticing him noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達、引っ越して、かくして寂しくなったよ。
lines.en: My friend moved away, and now I feel sad.
lines.style: Quiet statement of fact. Vulnerability without performance. Simple, aching sincerity. Voice getting smaller toward the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、初めての場所では、戸惑ったね、最初。
lines.en: Yes, and at the beginning, new places confused you, didn't they.
lines.style: Soft recognition. Not fixing it — just acknowledging he's been through this before. Patient, knowing. Voice stays steady and warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夜空の星、うっとりするね、ママ。
lines.en: Mom, the stars in the night sky — they make me feel so enchanted.
lines.style: Wonder-struck, almost breathless. Voice opens up toward the stars. Slow, savouring each word. Reaching for the feeling and finding it as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: よく噛む子は、頭、よくなるんだって。
lines.en: Kids who chew well grow smarter, they say.
lines.style: Gentle, practical wisdom shared aloud. Not lecturing — just a thought she's passing along while they're together. Warm, almost conspiratorial, like a small secret about how the world works.
